newsitem.title: USA: HealthSouth has offered to buy large pieces of Columbia/HCA Healthcare - Journal.
newsitem.headline: HealthSouth has offered to buy large pieces of Columbia/HCA Healthcare - Journal.

text.p: HealthSouth Corp has offered to buy large pieces of embattled hospital giant Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.
HealthSouth made its offers after a $45 a share takeover bid for Columbia late last month, the Journal reported.
Columbia did not respond to the bid, the paper said, and as a result HealthSouth withdrew it in favor of buying certain pieces of Columbia.
Those pieces include Columbia's rehabilitation facilities, surgery centers, occupational clinics and diagnostic units, the newspaper said.
The HealthSouth offer comes amid an ongoing federal investigation in recent months into Columbia's business practices.
Columbia's chief executive, Richard Scott, was ousted last month and two more executives aligned with Scott have resigned, the Journal reported Friday.
